QuestInfo.name: [Identisk] Mysterious Benefactor
QuestInfo.0: The leader of Iden Island, #p9062961#, is looking for the benefactor who helped #p9062966#. But they're nowhere to be found.
QuestInfo.1:
Where is the benefactor who helped #p9062966#? They must be somewhere on Identisk... Maybe you can find them from a higher vantage point.

#b(* If a problem occurs during the quest, forfeit the quest and try again.)
QuestInfo.2: You've finally found #p9062967#. He waved off your praise, saying that helping #p9062966# wasn't a big deal. Maybe he's embarrassed by the attention...

npc.0: You haven't found the benefactor yet? The only place I haven't looked is high up there...

item.0: Who are you? I'm sure we've never met... Don't talk to me.
